symptoms.name: Fever
symptoms.description: Elevated body temperature, often a natural immune response to infection.

symptoms.name: Headache
symptoms.description: Pain or discomfort in the head, temples, scalp, or neck area.

symptoms.name: Fatigue
symptoms.description: Persistent tiredness, lethargy, or lack of physical and mental energy.

symptoms.name: Body Aches
symptoms.description: Generalized muscular soreness, stiffness, or systemic bodily discomfort.

symptoms.name: Chills & Shivering
symptoms.description: Feeling cold with involuntary shivering, often preceding or accompanying fever.

symptoms.name: Dizziness & Lightheadedness
symptoms.description: Feeling lightheaded, unsteady, faint, or experiencing a spinning sensation.

symptoms.name: Cough
symptoms.description: Sudden forceful expulsion of air from lungs, dry or producing mucus/phlegm.

symptoms.name: Sore Throat
symptoms.description: Scratchy, painful, or irritated sensation in the throat, often worse when swallowing.

symptoms.name: Runny Nose & Sneezing
symptoms.description: Nasal discharge, rhinorrhea, and frequent sneezing from irritation or infection.

symptoms.name: Nasal & Sinus Congestion
symptoms.description: Stuffy nose with feeling of fullness or pressure around the sinuses and forehead.

symptoms.name: Shortness of Breath
symptoms.description: Feeling winded or struggling to breathe comfortably at rest or mild exertion.

symptoms.name: Nausea
symptoms.description: Queasy stomach discomfort with the urge or sensation of needing to vomit.

symptoms.name: Vomiting
symptoms.description: Involuntary oral expulsion of stomach contents.

symptoms.name: Diarrhea
symptoms.description: Frequent, loose, or watery bowel movements causing potential fluid loss.

symptoms.name: Stomach & Abdominal Pain
symptoms.description: Cramping, aching, or localized discomfort in the abdominal area.

symptoms.name: Joint Stiffness & Pain
symptoms.description: Soreness, inflammation, or restricted movement in knees, wrists, or other joints.

symptoms.name: Back Pain
symptoms.description: Aching or sharp tension along the lumbar spine or upper shoulder region.

symptoms.name: Skin Rash or Irritation
symptoms.description: Redness, itchiness, bumps, or localized skin eruption.

symptoms.name: Ear Pain
symptoms.description: Dull ache, sharp throb, or feeling of pressure within one or both ears.

symptoms.name: Loss of Taste or Smell
symptoms.description: Sudden or gradual reduction in ability to smell aromas or taste flavors.

symptoms.name: Sleep Disturbance
symptoms.description: Difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or unrefreshing fragmented sleep.
